entries.question: Ye batao ki entrance exam kaisa hota he Hard ya kaisa
entries.answer:
Entrance exam ka level **"competitive"** hota hai. KGMU mein admission ke liye hone wala entrance exam kaisa hoga, iske baare mein kuch mukhya baatein niche di gayi hain:

1. **Level:** Exam ka level **12th standard (10+2)** ke Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology (PCB) syllabus par aadharit hota hai. Agar aapne NCERT ki books aur 12th ka syllabus acche se padha hai, toh aapke liye exam clear karna mushkil nahi hoga.
2. **Competition:** Kyunki KGMU ek bahut bada aur pratisthit (prestigious) institution hai, isliye seats ke liye competition kaafi zyada hota hai. Isliye sirf exam pass karna kaafi nahi hota, aapko **merit list mein aane ke liye acche marks** laane padte hain.
3. **Exam Pattern:** Aam taur par ismein objective type (MCQs) sawal puche jaate hain. Aapko syllabus aur pichle saalon ke papers (agar available hon) ko dekhkar taiyari karni chahiye.
4. **Taiyari:** 
   * **NCERT par focus karein:** Physics, Chemistry aur Biology ki NCERT books ko acche se padhein.
   * **Practice:** MCQs ki practice karein taaki aapki speed aur accuracy badhe.
   * **Previous Year Papers:** Agar KGMU ki website par koi sample paper ya pichle saal ke papers milte hain, toh unhe zaroor solve karein.

**Hard ya Easy?**
* Yeh aapki taiyari par nirbhar karta hai. Agar aapne concept clear rakhe hain aur mehnat ki hai, toh exam manageable hota hai. 
* Lekin, seat kam hone aur candidates zyada hone ki wajah se, ise "easy" nahi kaha ja sakta. Iske liye ek disciplined study plan ki zaroorat hoti hai.

Aap admission notification aane ka intezaar karein, usmein syllabus ki poori jankari di hoti hai. Aap apni taiyari 12th ke syllabus ko base maan kar abhi se shuru kar sakte hain.

entries.question: Agr me optometry krunga to me sirf lens aur eye ke bare me padh lunn ya sara padhna padta he
entries.answer:
BSc Optometry ek professional medical course hai, isliye ismein aapko sirf "lens aur aankhon" ke upar hi nahi, balki unhe samajhne ke liye **medical science ke kai zaroori subjects** bhi padhne padte hain.

Aapka syllabus mainly in cheezon ka mishran (mix) hota hai:

**1. Core Optometry Subjects (Aankhein aur Vision):**
*   **Ocular Anatomy & Physiology:** Aankh ki banaavat aur uska kaam karne ka tarika.
*   **Optics:** Light, lenses, prisms aur vision kaise kaam karta hai.
*   **Clinical Refraction:** Aankhon ki jaanch karke chashme ka number nikalna.
*   **Binocular Vision:** Dono aankhon ka ek saath milkar kaam karna.
*   **Contact Lenses & Low Vision Aids:** Lens lagana aur kam dekhne waale mareezon ki madad karna.

**2. Basic Medical Subjects (Jo zaroori hain):**
*   **Human Anatomy & Physiology:** Poore sharir ka structure aur function (kyunki aankh bhi sharir ka hissa hai).
*   **Biochemistry & Pathology:** Shareerik aur aankhon ki bimariyon ko samajhne ke liye.
*   **Microbiology:** Aankhon mein hone wale infections aur unke kaaran.
*   **Pharmacology:** Aankhon mein daali jaane wali dawaiyon (eye drops) ka asar.

**3. Clinical Training:**
*   Sirf kitabi gyaan nahi, balki aapko hospital mein **OPD aur labs** mein patients ko dekhna, machine chalana aur doctors ke saath kaam karna sikhaya jata hai.

**Saar (Summary):**
Aap sirf chashme ya lens tak seemit nahi rahenge. Ek Optometrist ko aankh ki bimariyon ka pata lagana, unhe diagnose karna aur vision care dena hota hai, isliye aapko **Human Body, General Medicine aur Pathology** ki basic samajh hona bahut zaroori hai.

Yeh ek bahut hi respect aur career ke scope waala course hai, jismein aapko medical field ka achha gyaan milta hai. 

Kya aapne KGMU ke department of Ophthalmology ke baare mein padha hai? Aap yahan [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=21&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=21&dept_type=2) par jaakar dekh sakte hain.

entries.question: Are nhi yar me entrance exam ke liye puch rha hu
entries.answer:
Entrance exam ke liye aapko **poora syllabus (Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology)** padhna padega, sirf aankhon (Optometry) ke baare mein nahi.

Entrance exam mein aapka selection is baat par hota hai ki aapne 12th tak jo science padhi hai, usmein aap kitne strong hain. Entrance exam ka pattern kuch aisa hota hai:

1. **Physics:** Ismein mechanics, optics (light), electricity, aur baaki 12th ke topics aate hain.
2. **Chemistry:** Ismein organic, inorganic, aur physical chemistry ke questions hote hain.
3. **Biology:** Ismein Botany aur Zoology (plant aur animal science) dono aate hain.

**Entrance exam mein Optometry ke sawal nahi aate**, kyunki entrance exam ka maqsad ye check karna hota hai ki aapka **"Science ka base"** kitna mazboot hai. 

**Entrance exam clear karne ke liye aapko:**
* **11th aur 12th ki NCERT books** ko line-by-line padhna hoga.
* Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology teeno subjects par barabar dhyan dena hoga.
* Entrance exam mein wahi syllabus aata hai jo aapne school mein science stream mein padha hai.

Jab aap exam clear kar lenge aur admission mil jayega, tab college mein aapko Optometry (aankhon aur lens) ke baare mein specialize karwaya jayega. Abhi aapka pura focus **11th-12th ki Science** par hona chahiye.

To get admission to King George's Medical University (KGMU), please note that the process depends on the specific course you are interested in (e.g., MBBS, BDS, MD/MS, Nursing, or Paramedical).

KGMU generally follows national-level entrance examinations for its programs. You can find detailed information regarding courses and the admission process on the official website here: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

**General Admission Guidelines:**
*   **MBBS/BDS:** Admission is based on the **NEET-UG** examination conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).
*   **Postgraduate (MD/MS/Diploma):** Admission is based on the **NEET-PG** examination.
*   **Super-specialty (DM/MCh):** Admission is based on the **NEET-SS** examination.
*   **Nursing/Paramedical:** Admission is often conducted through specific entrance examinations managed by the university or state-level boards.

I recommend checking the [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) regularly for official admission brochures and application timelines for the current academic year.

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.
